fileName: Full interview with Karbi language speaker D.S. Teron.flac
title: Full interview with Karbi language speaker D.S. Teron
description: The full 53-minute interview with Dharamsing Teron (D.S. Teron), a Karbi speaker from Karbi Anglong district, Assam, India. It covers the introduction and his name (00:00–01:48), the meaning of "Karbi" (01:48–03:27), his birthplace (03:27–04:18) and children's games (04:18–08:52). It then moves to the Karbi language (08:52–15:09), storytelling (15:09–27:21), a folk song (27:21–31:03), festivals (31:03–42:30) and his daily activities (42:30–52:37). Subhashish Panigrahi interviewed him remotely, with his permission, on 21 May 2017. mjw001 to mjw009 are the same interview in nine parts.
